Compose the secure daemon API host (#170)

codeon:
  version: 1
  authority: fewensa-56
  description: |-
    ## Summary
    
    - add strict disabled-by-default API configuration with bounded limits, compiled version validation, loopback/TLS-terminated deployment modes, explicit listener failure policy, exact origins, and environment-only credentials
    - derive constant-time Bearer identities into bounded Actor, Profile, scope, idempotency, and optimistic-version request context
    - serve the sealed `codeon-api` foundation on a separate readiness-gated listener with loaded Profile and PostgreSQL query services, safe diagnostics, security headers, independent limits, and bounded shutdown
    - preserve disabled-mode and MCP behavior with focused configuration, listener, lifecycle, and MCP regression coverage

    - `cargo test -p codeon --test config` (46 passed)
    - `cargo test -p codeon --lib daemon::api::tests` (7 passed)
    - `cargo test -p codeon --lib daemon::runtime::tests` (6 passed)
    - `cargo test -p codeon --test mcp_security` (1 passed)
    - `cargo clippy -p codeon --all-targets -- -D warnings`
